goal: Expose and enforce DB-harness-first generation in the web /api/ask path, not only MCP/OpenClaw tools.

focusedTests.command: npm.cmd test -- tests/quality-contract.test.ts tests/ai-deliverables-prompts.test.ts tests/commercial-harness.test.ts tests/run-ask-mode.test.ts

notes: The enhanced/full web generation path now builds a DB harness packet from safety_reference_items before AI deliverable prompts are generated.
The prompt context includes a DB harness contract section that tells the LLM to naturalize fixed evidence only.
The final AskResponse exposes dbHarness.packet, dbHarness.promptContext, and dbHarness.summary so UI and saved workpacks can distinguish DB harness generation from a plain LLM response.
Template mode remains a no-external-call demo mode and is intentionally marked blocked in qualityContract.dbHarness.
